Patient.template: Using only the retrieved PostgreSQL schema metadata, find the relation or joins that represent a patient in any of these source schemas: {source_schemas}. Generate one SELECT filtered to patient key {patient_key}. Return exactly one row and these aliases: patient key AS _patient_key, administrative gender AS _gender, death date/time AS _death_datetime. Use NULL only for unavailable optional values. Do not assume any table or column name. Fully qualify every relation.

Encounter.template: Using only the retrieved PostgreSQL schema metadata, find the relation or joins that represent encounters or visits in any of these source schemas: {source_schemas}. Generate a SELECT filtered to patient key {patient_key}{encounter_override_clause}. Return: patient key AS _patient_key, encounter/visit key AS _encounter_key, a documented source encounter/admission type column AS _encounter_type, start date/time AS _start_datetime, end date/time AS _end_datetime. Every output expression MUST be a documented source column or NULL. A quoted label such as 'Encounter', 'Admission', or 'ICU Stay' is forbidden. Order by start date/time descending nulls last and limit {limit}. Do not assume any table or column name. Fully qualify every relation.

Condition.template: Using only the retrieved PostgreSQL schema metadata, select one best clinical relation for diagnoses or conditions in any of these source schemas: {source_schemas}, plus at most one matching dictionary relation when its join columns are documented. Do not combine procedures, billing events, or multiple condition sources. Generate a SELECT filtered to patient key {patient_key} and encounter keys in ({encounter_keys}). Return: patient key AS _patient_key, encounter key AS _encounter_key, a non-null unique stable condition-row key built from documented columns AS _resource_key, code AS _code, canonical code-system URI AS _code_system only when stored in a source column otherwise NULL, source description from an actually joined documented dictionary column AS _display otherwise NULL. Every expression must use documented columns or NULL. Never invent values, descriptions, systems, or placeholder text. Order deterministically and limit {limit}. Fully qualify every relation.

Procedure.template: Using only the retrieved PostgreSQL schema metadata, select one best clinical relation for patient procedures in any of these source schemas: {source_schemas}, plus at most one matching dictionary relation when documented. Do not combine diagnoses, billing events, or multiple procedure sources. Generate a SELECT filtered to patient key {patient_key} and encounter keys in ({encounter_keys}). Return: patient key AS _patient_key, encounter key AS _encounter_key, a non-null unique key built only from that procedure row's documented key columns AS _resource_key, procedure code AS _code, an actual stored canonical URI column AS _code_system otherwise NULL, an actual dictionary description column AS _display otherwise NULL, procedure date/time AS _event_datetime. Every expression must use documented columns or NULL; quoted clinical labels and fallback literals are forbidden. Order deterministically and limit {limit}. Fully qualify every relation.

Observation.template: Using only the retrieved PostgreSQL schema metadata, select one best event relation for observations or laboratory results in any of these source schemas: {source_schemas}, plus at most one matching dictionary relation. The selected event relation MUST contain an actual documented test, item, measurement, or observation code column; select that source value AS _code and never return NULL for _code. If a relation has no code column, choose another relation. Generate a SELECT filtered to patient key {patient_key} and encounter keys in ({encounter_keys}). Return: patient key AS _patient_key, encounter key AS _encounter_key, an event-row identifier AS _resource_key that is non-null and unique across every returned row. Never use a patient, encounter, visit, or stay key alone as _resource_key; use a documented event-row key or concatenate enough documented event columns to distinguish rows. Also return the required source observation code AS _code, canonical code-system URI AS _code_system when stored otherwise NULL, source display AS _display, event date/time AS _event_datetime, numeric value AS _value_number, text value AS _value_text, display unit AS _unit, canonical unit-system URI AS _unit_system only when stored otherwise NULL, canonical unit code AS _unit_code only when stored otherwise NULL, reference low AS _reference_low, reference high AS _reference_high, interpretation AS _interpretation. Never invent or normalize unsupported source values. Order deterministically and limit {limit}. Fully qualify every relation.
